findings.finding: Lower-to-upper separation constraints can be locally coherent and globally cyclic. The face-to-panel merge example is abstract, not a newly admissible FOLD fixture. Rigid cycle refusal is conditional on positive thickness and does not certify manufacture.

At zero thickness, source graph cyclicity persists with null rigid levels/height and false refusal, while ply height is separately0. An unknown cross-panel overlap prevents exact face levels; a partial lower bound cannot invent its completion.

The gain is dimensional and convergence interval strict for all initial errors in the stipulated current-residual recurrence. Boundary averages hide oscillation; the one-update delay changes the characteristic equation. No physical clock, controller or native solver was measured.

Finite exact law signatures identify catalogue entries under their premises, not a learner mental model. P2 energy aliases T/D/I but P1/P3 energy separates all four. An uncatalogued law agrees on all four probes and differs at60degrees.

The plan follows initial reading/hand-worked examples. A typed graph checker, direct small matrix solve and written feedback are simpler comparison baselines; no normative DSL, solver or tutor architecture was adopted.

P0angle0,u[1,0] gives T/F/Dforce[4,0] versus I[2.5,0]. The fictional correct response leaves three catalogue laws compatible and cannot identify rotation reasoning; these are authored laws, not observed populations.

P1forces T/D[1,0],F[4,0],I[2.5,0]; P2forces T[2.5,1.5],F[4,0],D/I[2.5,0]. The joint signature is unique within four stipulated laws; the fictional pair matches D, while P2 alone aliases D/I. Slips, guessing and unlisted rules prevent psychological diagnosis.

P2energy is1.25 for T/D/I and2 for F because u_y=0 removes the transverse contribution. P1/P3 energy pairs are T(0.5,1),F(2,2.5),D(0.5,2.5),I(1.25,2.5), distinguishing all four; scalar loss is probe-dependent, not universal.
